description: This file contains utility functions for accessing remote services and databases related to the JWQL project, specifically for retrieving configuration parameters and authentication tokens for MAST/ESO services.

methods.name: get_mast_base_url(request=None)
methods.description: Returns the base URL for mnemonic queries, checking first configuration settings, then environment variables.

methods.name: get_mast_token(request=None)
methods.description: Retrieves the MAST API token, either through Astroquery authentication status, configuration, or environment variables.
